# Apply Fixes

## Change Summary

No additional fixes were applied in this round because the latest review approved the implementation and provided no follow-up amendments.

## Steps

0. [Completed] Reviewed the latest implementation and review outputs to determine whether any additional fixes were requested.
1. [Completed] Confirmed the latest review outcome was approved and that the follow-up amendment list was empty.
2. [Skipped] Skipped code edits because there were no requested fixes to apply in this round.
3. [Completed] Recorded the no-op outcome and carried forward the latest relevant validation evidence from the prior stages.

## Validation Evidence

- Review payload `run-20260328125529-review-c2-a1-cr5` reported `outcome: approved` with an empty `follow_up_or_amendments` list.
- Latest existing verification from prior stages remains: `cargo test -p tank_core --lib` passed (49 tests), including legacy snapshot deserialization and fresh-carbonate TDS/conductivity coverage.
- Latest existing verification from prior stages remains: `cargo test -p tank_core --test concentration_helpers` passed (11 tests), including `tds_helpers_ignore_stale_bicarbonate_cache`.
- Latest existing verification from prior stages remains: `cargo test -p tank_tui --lib` passed (10 tests), including enriched snapshot/load compatibility and shared NH3-N unit-label coverage.
- Latest existing verification from prior stages remains: `cargo test -p tank_api` passed (3 tests), and `cargo clippy -p tank_core -p tank_api -p tank_tui -- -D warnings` completed successfully with no warnings.

## Outstanding Risks

- No new validation commands were run in this round because no code changed; the latest verification remains the targeted test and lint results recorded in the prior implementation and review stages.
- There is still a minor coverage gap around exact end-to-end TUI render text assertions; current tests cover labels, scope lines, and compatibility behavior rather than full-screen render snapshots.
- The overview hardware panel still trades layout space for estimate-scope transparency and may overflow on very small terminals.
- An unrelated clippy warning in `crates/tank_scenarios/src/lib.rs` remains outside the scope of this bead.
